about: WWE 2K14 DLC character ids (Session 32, 2026-10-19). Kept apart from characters.json on purpose: the launcher's Quick Match and tools/monkey read characters.json, and these ids only exist when their pack is on (--wwe2k14_dlc). The id is the archive pac\ch\chNNN_dlcPP.pac in pack PP (folder listing of Jarrod's packs, game_data\dlc (dlc_2 until 2026-10-19 11:20)). Every id loaded and played 30 s of a one-on-one Quick Match against Daniel Bryan (324) with its entrance on (runs 2446-2465, tools/input_scripts/short/dlc_pair.txt) and in the six-pack sweep (runs 2438-2441). Names only where the game or the pack's catalog shows them (CLAUDE.md: unknown is an acceptable answer); the match HUD shows no names.

evidence_key.catalog: the pack's info\catalog.dlc entry names this character id (tools/dlc/scan.py)
evidence_key.name_plate: the name plate on screen in the entrance (shot-checker on the run's dp_entrance.png)
evidence_key.tron_text: the name written in the titantron graphics (screenshot)
evidence_key.pair_run: the one-on-one Quick Match run: archive from its pack, entrance, 30 s of match
